description: Thomas Baldauf and Jonas Eschmann at DLR publish final industrial energy-demand outputs from an agent-based macroeconomic model for Man0EUvRE Case Study 3. It represents 30 industries in 11 European countries, calibrated to EXIOBASE 3.9.5. Two XLSX workbooks contain Monte Carlo means and medians from 20 repetitions, in IAMC long format with demand in EJ/year. The 2022 column denotes a post-shock equilibrium; model runs have 340 periods. Results are explicitly supplied for integration into GENeSYS-MOD. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. Related European energy scenarios are separate resources. The description says five scenarios but lists a reference plus five shocked variants, an unresolved count discrepancy. Only the 30 resolved industries have endogenous relocation; households, services and residual industry do not. A limitation is that the workbooks were not read and this numerical or sector-label inconsistency was not resolved.
